# opnsense_tailscale_settings (Resource)

Tailscale settings (**VPN ▸ Tailscale ▸ Settings**, plugin `os-tailscale`): service, port, DNS, exit node and subnet routing. Advertised subnets are `opnsense_tailscale_subnet` resources. This is a singleton: import it with the ID `tailscale_settings` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_tailscale_settings.this
  id = "tailscale_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_tailscale_settings" "this" {
  enabled              = true
  accept_subnet_routes = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `accept_dns` (Boolean) Use the DNS settings of the tailnet.
- `accept_subnet_routes` (Boolean) Accept the subnet routes advertised by other nodes.
- `advertise_exit_node` (Boolean) Offer this firewall as an exit node.
- `disable_snat` (Boolean) Do not masquerade traffic to the advertised subnets.
- `enable_ssh` (Boolean) Enable Tailscale SSH on this node.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable Tailscale. The node must be authenticated, see `opnsense_tailscale_authentication`.
- `exit_node` (String) Exit node to route internet traffic through, empty for none.
- `listen_port` (Number) UDP port of the WireGuard tunnel. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `login_timeout` (Number) Seconds to wait for the login when the service starts. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `tailscale_settings`.
